_comment: Shared settings for the Foundry DE plugin. The hooks read this file. Change values here, not in the hook script. No passwords or tokens in this file.

reports._comment: Folder where each skill saves <skill>_<batch>_report.md. A relative path is read from the CoCo workspace folder. You can also put a full path, for example D:\\Claude\\coco-workspace\\pipeline-reports

pipeline._comment: Skills in run order. scope=design: approved once, using design_batch_id. scope=batch: approved again for every new current_batch_id.

approval._comment: The human types this word, then the skill name, in the CoCo chat. Example: APPROVE de-deep-profile
